basic_info.description: Located in bucolic Glen Park, this charming three-bedroom, two-bath home offers neighborhood views, a deep southwest facing parcel and tons of potential.  Several of the neighbors have, or are currently adding, ADUs (Accessory Dwelling Units); so let the exploration and your imagination take flight!  Whether you are envisioning a family compound or looking for additional income, this property offers rare flexibility in a prime San Francisco location.  The current owners have lovingly lived in and improved the home over many years, adding onto and enhancing the home's efficient layout, thoughtfully remodeling both bathrooms and creating a blank canvas to complete your own personal touches, particularly in the airy kitchen, which is ripe to be reimagined into a modern culinary and entertaining space.  A private patio off the primary suite completes the feeling of a spa-like retreatideal for relaxing mornings or peaceful evenings.  The spacious garage includes extra storage, perfect for bikes, tools, or seasonal items.  Enjoy easy access to local shops, parks, BART, and all that Glen Park has to offer.
